messages:
alex: Quick q — I'm moving provider blocks out of the payments module and into the root as part of the refactor. Two quick concerns: 1) will our private terraform registry mirror / provider source mapping break? 2) I need to regen the lockfile and do a staging smoke plan. cc @maria @sam

maria: In general moving to root is fine. If the module used aliased providers you need to either pass the provider in the module call or make the module accept providers via arguments. Also confirm required_providers in the module matches the root mapping.

alex: example snippets — root provider I plan to add:
```hcl
# root/main.tf
provider "aws" {
  region = "us-west-2"
  alias  = "payments"
}
```
and the module call currently:
```hcl
module "payments" {
  source = "git::ssh://git@our-registry/payments//modules/core?ref=v2"
  # module used to declare its own provider inside
}
```

sam: If the module declared a provider block before, hoisting is fine but you might hit the "no provider configuration found" error unless the module's `providers` meta-argument is set where needed. Also check that module's `required_providers` source stanza points to the same provider namespace (mirror).

anya: For lockfile: run from repo root:
```bash
terraform providers lock -platform=linux_amd64 -platform=linux_arm64
terraform init -upgrade -backend-config=...
```
That regenerates terraform.lock.hcl with mirror entries. I did that on payments last week.

alex: Good — thanks. One more thing: our helm chart values reference a k8s secret that the module used to create at `payments-creds`. Moving providers doesn't change that, but the module refactor moves how the secret path is namespaced. Need to confirm values.yaml references.

maria: Yep — if module now creates secret under namespace `infra/` you need to update the chart values. Change `existingSecret: payments-creds` -> `existingSecret: infra/payments-creds` or whatever the new path is.

infra-bot: Running quick staging plan (automated) — expected result: terraform.lock.hcl update only. Plan job started.

alex: Plan URL (internal): https://terraform.internal/plans/plan-abc123 — plan summary below. Can someone eyeball?

```
Plan: 0 to add, 0 to change, 0 to destroy.
Note: terraform.lock.hcl will be updated
```

sam: I'll take a look. If plan is only lockfile, that's low-risk. Ping me when you open the PR. Also search for hardcoded provider source like `hashicorp/aws` inside modules — we use our mirror override in root provider mapping.

anya: Quick provenance check: run `terraform providers mirror` if you need to produce a local mirror, but not necessary for CI if init is configured with our registry. Also add a short PR checklist: lockfile regen, helmvalues update, run staging apply, smoke verify.

maria: Suggest adding a short note in the PR description about provider aliasing and the helm secretpath change so infra/eng-sre knows to watch the canary.

alex: Will do. I'll update PR with commands I ran and the plan link, then run canary apply to staging. Thanks for the fast checks :thumbsup:

sam: LGTM from me — will monitor staging logs.

anya: :+1: Also add `TF_LOG=TRACE` if provider plugin errors crop up during init — helps debug source mapping issues.

alex: Done, PR updated and canary apply kicked off. Marking thread resolved unless anyone sees problems. Thanks!
